install_steps: npm install -g promptfoo  # or: npx promptfoo@latest
note: Node.js 18+. Evals need provider credentials (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ...) or a local provider — supports ollama: and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so fully-local evals work. 'promptfoo view' opens a local web UI for results; everything else is headless. Also ships a Homebrew formula.
